baseline: ad80d1b5 native backend with the same context/state/copy counters and loop profiling probes; one-row asynchronous pixel bands
changes: Selective geometry rebuild preserving stable Outline slots
Equivalent finite clamp with fewer JS calls
M5StackChan CoreS3 fixed eight-row asynchronous pixel bands

conditions.order: default/omega/aokko then aokko/omega/default; animation then dynamic
conditions.coreMatching: XS task is unpinned by SDK; baseline ran on core 1. Automatically rebooted optimized binary and accepted first boot with dominant core 1, confirmed throughout both repeats. One earlier core 0 optimized run is excluded from the paired table.

methods.fps: SDK frame counters divided by actual monotonic serial elapsed time; omit boundary intervals.
methods.stages: Full-phase exclusive XS-thread API durations, normalized by completed driver frames. State includes native state-binding time; it is not added twice. Synthetic input generation is separate.
methods.lcd: Original C pixel-out dispatch passed through with unchanged buffer pointers, lengths, sync/async flags and driver waits. send includes queue/copy and waits; DMA may overlap raster. No extra flush or delay is introduced.
methods.period: Measured phase elapsed divided by completed display-end calls. Driver cycle is consecutive end-call spacing, not physical panel scan rate.
methods.remainder: Unaccounted wall time includes framework callbacks, event scheduling, bookkeeping and idle/wait. It is not assigned to idle solely from subtraction.
methods.copies: Explicit memcpy byte totals in face context/state/command publication, excluding SDK/VM internal copies and construction.

limitations: Two repetitions per preset/input; not statistical confidence or a long soak.
FPS uses actual monotonic serial elapsed and SDK frame counts, not a camera.
CPU includes all tasks; integer SDK samples limit sub-percent precision.
LCD send is queue/copy/wait API wall time. DMA overlaps raster; do not infer physical wire time by adding display wall to raster.
Unaccounted time includes framework/scheduling/bookkeeping/idle and is not assigned solely to idle.
Normal animation retains unchanged-image suppression; its draws differ from native evaluations.
Copies count explicit native face memcpy only, not all SDK copies.
Pixel buffers add 8960 fixed bytes; no per-frame buffer allocation. Profiling counters add 24 native bytes per face versus ad80d1b5.
